candidates.researchQuestion: When a delegated digital employee reaches a sensitive review point, what evidence should be allowed to carry user authorization across agent boundaries without letting forwarded or assistant-authored text impersonate authority?
candidates.title: Authorization Needs Provenance, Not Persuasive Wording
candidates.title_zh: 授权需要来源，不需要更像真的措辞
candidates.coreProposition: For delegated digital employees, authorization provenance should travel through a structured review-plane evidence channel whose authoritative source and role remain separate from work-plane prose; this improves admission decisions, but long-lived, scoped and revocable authority still requires a distinct durable authorization state.

sections.heading: What a message says is not where it came from
sections.heading_zh: 消息说了什么，不等于消息来自哪里

sections.heading: Put authority evidence on the review plane
sections.heading_zh: 把授权证据放在 Review Plane

sections.heading: Evidence observed is not authority granted
sections.heading_zh: Reviewer 看见的证据，不等于 Executor 获得的权限

sections.heading: A safer admission boundary, not an authorization guarantee
sections.heading_zh: 更安全的 Admission Boundary，不是 Authorization Guarantee

evidenceClaims.claim: Merged Codex code resolves the actual root thread and extracts bounded structured root conversation evidence for non-root MultiAgent V2 Guardian review.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Codex 已合并代码会解析真实 Root Thread，并为非 Root 的 MultiAgent V2 Guardian Review 提取有界、结构化的 Root Conversation Evidence。

evidenceClaims.claim: The extracted evidence preserves User and Assistant roles, and only structured root-user messages are designated as authorization evidence.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 提取出的 Evidence 保留 User 与 Assistant Role，而且只有结构化 Root-user Message 被指定为 Authorization Evidence。

evidenceClaims.claim: Summaries, synthetic user_action items, review artifacts and forwarded or assistant-authored claims cannot become root-user authorization merely by wording.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Summary、Synthetic user_action、Review Artifact 以及 Forwarded 或 Assistant-authored Claim 不会仅凭措辞变成 Root-user Authorization。

evidenceClaims.claim: The evidence channel is bounded to recent eligible root messages and per-message Guardian token limits and is isolated from the ordinary worker context.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Evidence Channel 受最近 Eligible Root Message 与单条 Guardian Token Limit 约束，并与普通 Worker Context 隔离。

evidenceClaims.claim: Authorization provenance should travel on a structured review-plane evidence channel rather than through natural-language work-plane claims.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Authorization Provenance 应通过结构化 Review-plane Evidence Channel 传递，而不是通过 Work-plane Natural-language Claim。

evidenceClaims.claim: A rotating review evidence window is an admission aid, not a durable state machine for scoped, fresh and revocable authorization.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 会轮转的 Review Evidence Window 是 Admission Aid，而不是用于限定 Scope、保持 Fresh、可撤销 Authorization 的持久 State Machine。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion concerns general authorization provenance for delegated digital employees and multi-agent systems.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already serves the transferable engineering audience; a separate community edition would not add a distinct evidence subset or discussion structure.

candidates.researchQuestion: How should a remote execution architecture combine policies owned by different authorities so that protected constraints cannot be weakened while explicitly reviewable access can still expand under governance?
candidates.title: Protected Constraints and Reviewable Grants Need Different Merge Rules
candidates.title_zh: 受保护约束与可审查授权，需要不同合并规则
candidates.coreProposition: Multi-owner remote-execution policy should compose monotonically for explicitly protected constraints while representing every permitted expansion as a separate reviewable transition with defined scope and invalidation; the effective policy must be revalidated after composition and enforced across escalation paths.

sections.heading: A set operation cannot express authority ownership
sections.heading_zh: Set Operation 无法表达 Authority Ownership

sections.heading: Asymmetric composition preserves the ceiling
sections.heading_zh: 非对称组合才能保住 Ceiling

sections.heading: Expansion belongs in a transition, not in precedence
sections.heading_zh: Expansion 应属于 Transition，而不是 Precedence

sections.heading: Validate the result and every route that can execute it
sections.heading_zh: 验证结果，也验证所有执行路径

sections.heading: The demonstrated boundary is network policy
sections.heading_zh: 已展示边界仅限 Network Policy

evidenceClaims.claim: Merged Codex code composes EnvironmentNetworkPolicy with controller constraints rather than granting attachment policy wholesale proxy authority.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Codex 已合并代码把 EnvironmentNetworkPolicy 与 Controller Constraint 组合，而不是把完整 Proxy Authority 交给 Attachment Policy。

evidenceClaims.claim: Inherited domain denials are restored and socket or permissive boolean grants are intersected so protected denial remains dominant.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Inherited Domain Denial 会被恢复，Socket 与 Permissive Boolean Grant 通过 Intersection 组合，使 Protected Denial 保持优先。

evidenceClaims.claim: Strict attachment allowlists and fixed controller ceilings suppress approval-based expansion, while saved grants enter only reviewable paths.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Strict Attachment Allowlist 与 Fixed Controller Ceiling 抑制 Approval-based Expansion，而 Saved Grant 只进入可 Review Path。

evidenceClaims.claim: The tool path rejects sandbox escalation that would bypass attachment-owned network policy and validates the composed effective proxy policy.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Tool Path 会拒绝绕过 Attachment-owned Network Policy 的 Sandbox Escalation，并验证组合后的 Effective Proxy Policy。

evidenceClaims.claim: Later layers may preserve or narrow a protected ceiling but should not silently erase it.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 后续 Layer 可以保留或收紧 Protected Ceiling，但不应静默擦除它。

evidenceClaims.claim: Legitimate expansion should be a separate reviewable transition rather than a hidden consequence of merge precedence.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Legitimate Expansion 应成为独立 Reviewable Transition，而不是隐藏在 Merge Precedence 中的结果。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion concerns general multi-owner policy composition for remote-execution architecture.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already addresses the architecture problem; a separate community edition would not add a distinct professional angle.

candidates.researchQuestion: How should an asynchronous local cache reconcile an authoritative remote inventory when principal identity can change and refresh, install, uninstall and cancellation can race with destructive cleanup?
candidates.title: A Missing Cache Entry Is Not Deletion Evidence
candidates.title_zh: 缓存里没有，不足以授权删除
candidates.coreProposition: Asynchronous authoritative-cache reconciliation should bind each snapshot to both principal identity and causal generation, serialize participating mutation paths, reject stale publication and require positive completeness evidence before destructive cleanup, while modeling remote membership separately from local materialization readiness.

sections.heading: Coordinate every writer represented by the guarantee
sections.heading_zh: 协调所有被 Guarantee 覆盖的 Writer

sections.heading: Model remote truth and local readiness separately
sections.heading_zh: 分开建模 Remote Truth 与 Local Readiness

evidenceClaims.claim: Merged Codex code adds a composite authentication identity to remote installed-plugin cache state and loaded-plugin cache keys.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Codex 已合并代码把 Composite Authentication Identity 加入 Remote Installed-plugin Cache State 与 Loaded-plugin Cache Key。

evidenceClaims.claim: Generation and reconciliation-generation guards allow publication only while expected causal state and authentication identity still match.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Generation 与 Reconciliation-generation Guard 只在预期 Causal State 与 Authentication Identity 仍匹配时允许 Publication。

evidenceClaims.claim: Full sync, reconciliation, direct install and uninstall share a per-cache-root gate, with per-plugin markers protecting in-flight mutations from stale cleanup.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Full Sync、Reconciliation、Direct Install 与 Uninstall 共享 Per-cache-root Gate，Per-plugin Marker 防止 In-flight Mutation 被 Stale Cleanup 误删。

evidenceClaims.claim: The complete remote snapshot is canonicalized before download, publication or stale deletion, and valid installed metadata survives local materialization failure.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 完整 Remote Snapshot 会在 Download、Publication 或 Stale Deletion 前 Canonicalize，Valid Installed Metadata 会在 Local Materialization Failure 后保留。

evidenceClaims.claim: Cancellation clears the active reconciliation generation, advances generation and marks an effective-plugin refresh as required.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Cancellation 会清除 Active Reconciliation Generation、推进 Generation，并标记需要 Effective-plugin Refresh。

evidenceClaims.claim: A snapshot should publish only for the principal identity and causal generation under which it was fetched.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Snapshot 只应在其 Fetch 时对应的 Principal Identity 与 Causal Generation 仍有效时 Publish。

evidenceClaims.claim: Destructive cleanup requires positive completeness evidence and must not infer remote absence from partial refresh or local materialization failure.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Destructive Cleanup 需要正向 Completeness Evidence，不能从 Partial Refresh 或 Local Materialization Failure 推断 Remote Absence。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion concerns general asynchronous cache reconciliation and open-source runtime reliability.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already addresses the transferable engineering pattern; a separate community edition would not add a distinct evidence subset or discussion question.
